meeting_scene:
As Priya stood at the front of the room, surveying her team with a warm smile, she began to discuss their current projects and milestones ahead, ensuring everyone was on track for meeting deadlines like Alex's rapidly approaching marketing campaign that had been looming over them all week.

Jordan jumped in next, his enthusiasm infectious as he talked about some innovative new ideas he'd brainstormed during lunch. The team seemed enthralled by his suggestions, though it wasn't uncommon to see a slight flicker of concern on Sam's face when Jordan got particularly excited – this was the second time that meeting had come around and Alex would be handling sales in two days.

Vikram nodded along with everything Priya said but occasionally interjected just enough so everyone wouldn’t feel left out. His optimism inspired Riya, however - for some reason she seemed to really appreciate his encouragement as he discussed a project of their own that was getting underway the week following next Thu
